title: Well-Ordering and Choice are equivalent in ZF

standard_prerequisites.name: General Recursion theorem (set-theory spine chapter, Theorem transrecursionschema, source line 730)
standard_prerequisites.use: Licenses the transfinite recursion defining the enumeration term g; the author notes g is first only a term and must be shown to be a genuine function.

standard_prerequisites.name: Hartogs' lemma (set-theory-choice chapter, Lemma HartogsLemma, source line 674)
standard_prerequisites.use: Bounds the ordinals admitting injections into a set; contradicts a never-stopping run of the recursion, forcing it to stop.

core_obligations: Prove Well-Ordering implies Choice (proof lines 1207-1210): given a set A of sets, well-order its union (which exists by the Axiom of Union) and let f(x) be the least member of x under that ordering; verify f is a choice function for A.

Prove Choice implies the recursive enumeration is injective (proof lines 1212-1234): from a choice function f for the nonempty subsets of A define g by transfinite recursion with g(0)=f(A) and g(alpha)=f(A minus g[alpha]) unless A=g[alpha]; since g(alpha) is never in g[alpha], g(alpha)=g(beta) forces alpha=beta by Trichotomy, so g is injective.

Conclude the construction yields a well-ordering of A (proof lines 1236-1239): Hartogs' lemma rules out a never-stopping run, which would inject every ordinal into the nonempty subsets of A; hence the recursion stops with A=g[alpha] for some least alpha, g is a bijection from an ordinal onto A, and its enumeration order well-orders A.
proof_roadmap: Well-order the union of A and select least members (proof lines 1207-1210).
Define g by transfinite recursion on a choice function and prove g injective (proof lines 1212-1234).
Apply Hartogs' lemma to stop the recursion and read off the well-ordering (proof lines 1236-1239).
difficulty_reason: Two-direction ZF equivalence; the right-to-left direction needs the recursive construction, an injectivity argument via Trichotomy, and the Hartogs bound. Both cited ingredients are named with no omissions; 35-line proof.
